description: High-retention 90-120s vertical documentary format modeled after top-performing civil engineering shorts (42k+ views benchmark)

audience.demographic: Engineering, Megaprojects, Technology, and History enthusiasts

aesthetic_pillars.description: Dramatic 3D satellite earth flyover with topographic relief, glowing route lines, and clean typographic ocean/land callouts.
aesthetic_pillars.prompt_template: Cinematic 3D satellite earth flyover zooming down into {location}, topographic digital elevation relief map, emerald blue oceans, dramatic orbital camera push-in, 4k 60fps vertical 9:16

aesthetic_pillars.description: Authentic period dramatization with steam machinery, period workers, atmospheric smoke, volumetric lighting, and humid haze.
aesthetic_pillars.prompt_template: {year} historical construction site of {subject}, early 20th century industrial steam machinery puffing black smoke, workers in period clothing digging through mud and blasted rock in a steep canyon, cinematic historical documentary footage, 4k 60fps vertical 9:16

aesthetic_pillars.description: Transparent cutaway revealing subterranean engineering, fluid dynamics, magnetic fields, or hidden mechanics.
aesthetic_pillars.prompt_template: Architectural cutaway cross-section of {structure}, {subject} inside, transparent exterior showing subterranean {mechanism} discharging rushing foaming white water bubbles, 3D technical engineering visualization, photorealistic lighting, 4k 60fps vertical 9:16

aesthetic_pillars.description: Sweeping cinematic aerial drone tracking over megastructure landscapes.
aesthetic_pillars.prompt_template: Cinematic wide aerial drone shot flying over {megaproject}, dramatic scale, clear blue sky, photorealistic 8k vertical 9:16
